texts.orig: The main objective of this work is to show; through counterexamples; that some of the theorems presented in the papers of Sharma et al.  (2018) and Chauhan et al. 2021) are incorrect. Although used these theorems to establish sufficient condition for multi-twisted (MT) code to be linear complementary dual (LCD), we show that this condition itself remains   valid. We further improve this condition by removing the restrictions on the shift constants and relaxing the required coprimality condition. We show that compared to the previous condition; the modified condition is able to identify more LCD MT codes. Furthermore, without the need for normalized set of generators, we develop a formula to determine the dimension of any p-generator MT code. they
